edits.new:
This bidang usaha is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021's Lampiran II (p.4, entry 14 "Industri barang anyaman", sub-row "Rotan dan bambu"), so a PT PMA cannot register it. The steps below are the Koperasi/UMKM registration route, not a PMA one.
1. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id as a Koperasi/UMKM entity, select this code, issued automatically (1–3 days)
2. **Submit industrial data report every 6 months (Kemenperin)** — post-license obligation
3. **Menjamin keamanan dan keselamatan alat, proses, hasil produksi, penyimpanan, serta pengangkutan, ses...** — post-license obligation
4. **Memiliki dokumen legalitas bahan baku, berupa: a) Surat Keterangan Sahnya Hasil Hutan (SKSHH); b) Su...** — post-license obligation

**Authority by scale:**
Small: **Bupati/Walikota** (Otomatis) · Medium: **Bupati/Walikota** (Otomatis) · Large: **Gubernur** (Otomatis)

**PMA:** Closed to foreign investment — domestic entities only. Perpres 10/2021 Lampiran II (as replaced by 49/2021) allocates rattan and bamboo weaving to Koperasi and UMKM; a PT PMA cannot hold equity in this activity.

edits.new: Exporting woven bamboo and rattan bags from Bali? 16291 is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II, so it is not a PT PMA code — here is the Koperasi/UMKM registration route and the export licences.

edits.old: Setting up a PT PMA for this is fully open to 100% foreign ownership. You will need an Industrial Business License (IUI), and if you plan to export these goods, securing an NIK via the OSS system is critical. A common mistake is underestimating the IDR 2.5 billion minimum paid-up capital requirement for a PT PMA. Total investment must still exceed IDR 10 billion per 5-digit KBLI per location — a separate threshold from the paid-up minimum (Permen BKPM 5/2025 art. 26(2) and art. 26(10)).
edits.new: The activity is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II, so a PT PMA cannot register 16291 — the producers here are Indonesian cooperatives and MSMEs. Whoever operates it needs an Industrial Business License (IUI), and if the goods are exported, securing an NIK via the OSS system is critical.
